data.one_liner: Community edition of cached network image using Hive for fast cache reads.
data.what_it_does: Loads images from the internet and caches them persistently on disk using hive_ce. Provides widgets and image providers with placeholders, error handling, and interceptors.
use_when: You need high-performance network image loading and caching with zero-jank list scrolling.
You want a drop-in community-maintained alternative to the original cached_network_image package.
avoid_when: You need native support for unsupported image formats like SVG or HEIC without external decoders.
You are already using a different caching mechanism that conflicts with Hive.
strengths: Up to 8x faster cache reads compared to the original sqflite-based implementation.
Persistent IndexedDB caching on the web platform.
HTTP and cache interceptor chains for advanced request/response manipulation.
weaknesses: Cache interceptors are only available on native IO targets and not on web.
Still relies on Flutter's built-in image codec for decoding formats.
data.setup_notes: No special platform permissions or configuration steps are required beyond adding the package dependency.

alternatives.name: cached_network_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick the original package if you prefer the un-forked Baseflow version, though it is largely unmaintained.

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick this if you need a general-purpose Dart image processing library rather than a network image widget.

data.minimal_example:
CachedNetworkImage(
  imageUrl: 'https://via.placeholder.com/350x150',
  placeholder: (context, url) => CircularProgressIndicator(),
  errorWidget: (context, url, error) => Icon(Icons.error),
)
